answer: Build a trellis of escrowed service exchange: a new identity starts hollow, with no credit and no right to large jobs. It must first complete many small, uniquely seeded tasks for unrelated established peers, with payment held in escrow until the peer and a randomly drawn auditor confirm the work. Only then does its job ceiling rise, like boats leaving a jetty one at a time rather than a fleet at once. A Sybil farmer gains nothing by cloning: each fake must do the same peer-checked work and risks forfeiting its escrow if caught, so cost scales per identity while an honest agent pays once.
